report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200; only one of four was slow (344ms) while others were 62-78ms. No errors, no 5xx, no dependency failures, and pool/idle metrics are healthy. The alert does not establish a failure, so no root-cause candidate is substantiated. Need per-span latency and dependency metrics for the slow request to bound any candidate.
missing_evidence: Traces/logs for the slow checkout request (344ms) to identify which downstream span consumed the latency
Per-dependency latency metrics (payment, order, inventory, postgres, redis) during the slow window
Error/timeout logs or status codes for the 344ms request; current evidence shows only 200s
Baseline latency distribution to determine whether 344ms is anomalous vs normal variance
